data.name: yulgang next
data.detailed_description:
"YULGANG NEXT" is a perfect collision of classic and innovation, and it is also a legendary tale of the martial arts world that reignites passion and rekindles old bonds!

The game retains the nostalgic chibi style of the original"YULGANG NEXT"PC game, with a qualitative leap in artistic quality and a classic reproduction of the eight professions. Those classic features that accompanied you through countless days and nights, such as enhancement and synthesis, pet assistance, wilderness PK, and the battle between good and evil, are all recreated in "YULGANG NEXT", taking you back to that passionate and exciting world of the martial arts.

[Game Features]

-- Classic scene and character reproduction

The game highly reproduces the classic scenes from the original "Ragnarok Online", including:

Xuanbo Sect - the core of the martial arts orthodox sects, and the starting point for players entering the Jianghu.

Shenwu Gate - a prestigious and orthodox sect, where experts gather, shouldering the justice of the martial arts world.

Tiger Den Valley - a treacherous and perilous place, hiding numerous secret treasures of the martial arts world.

Beihai Ice Palace - a realm of extreme cold, where mysterious forces reside and hide-away conspiracies lurk.

Meanwhile, the game recreates classic characters such as Han Fei Guan, Tan Hualin, Xiao Xiang, and Tian Mo Shen Jun, allowing players to revisit the passionate stories in the familiar Jianghu.

-- Brand-new Storyline of the Bloodthirsty Jianghu

Based on the continuation of classic comic storylines, the game introduces a brand-new original storyline:

The player assumes the role of a disciple of the Xuanbo Sect, who, after accidentally acquiring one of the rare treasures, the "Fire Dragon Saber", falls victim to a strange poison and is compelled to embark on a journey in search of the treasure.

As the investigation deepens, players gradually discover that a mysterious force named "Shendi" is secretly manipulating the martial arts world, and a larger conspiracy emerges from the surface

NPC dialogues, side quests, hidden events, and other engaging gameplay elements immerse players in the world of the martial arts, where they experience the complexities of gratitude, resentment, love, and hatred.

-- Comprehensive upgrade of artistic style

On the basis of retaining the original Q-version style, the character models, scene details, skill special effects, and more have been comprehensively upgraded, resulting in a more exquisite and detailed visual presentation.

The alternation of day and night, coupled with changing weather, lends the world of the martial arts a greater sense of vividness.

Even without engaging in quests, simply strolling through the cherry blossom forest of the Xuanbo Sect, the snowy plains of the Beihai Ice Palace, or chatting with NPCs, one can still experience the unique charm of the Jianghu.

-- Exquisite facial customization system

Players can freely customize their character appearance, creating a unique image of a knight-errant:

A variety of styles are available, ranging from handsome knights to playful girls, catering to different aesthetics. Height, weight, and muscle definition can be fine-tuned to create personalized characters.

-- Battle between good and evil forces

Players can join either the "good faction" or the "evil faction" to experience different storylines and exclusive missions

New gameplay features such as the battlefield between good and evil, sect wars, and peak duels allow players to experience the thrill of different types of intense battles.

Strive for the title of "Best in the World" and become a legend in the martial arts world!

-- Unique Lightness Skill System

After completing the main quest, the character will unlock and learn the "Swift Dragon Soaring Through the Clouds" lightness skill, allowing them to fly on the wind, freely traverse the various regions of the Jianghu, and fully appreciate the beautiful scenery of the Jianghu.

-- New Pet Battle Assistance System

In the Jianghu, there are various pets hidden, and players can summon and cultivate their own exclusive battle pets.

Pets possess unique skills, such as healing, crowd control, burst damage, and more, to assist players in combat.

Pets will be the most loyal companions for players as they travel across the vast continent!

No matter what kind of gameplay you prefer,"YULGANG NEXT"provides you with a vast stage to fully showcase your charm and create your own legend in the martial arts world!

data.short_description: Yulgang NEXT blends timeless charm and fresh innovation, keeping the beloved Q-style art of the original PC game with stunning visuals. Gear enhancement, open-world PvP, and the epic Righteous vs. Evil faction war return. Raid bosses with friends or run stalls for gold. Forge your unique legend!
